crossRefs.note: Therefore keep the words of this covenant and do them, that you may prosper in all that you do.
Only be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe to do according to all the law which Moses my servant…
Only take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law which Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded you, to love…
May Yahweh give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel; that so you may keep the law of…
Then you will prosper, if you observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which Yahweh gave Moses concerning Israel.…
Now therefore, in the sight of all Israel, Yahweh’s assembly, and in the audience of our God, observe and seek out all…
You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for…
and give to Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep your commandments, your testimonies, and your statutes, and to do…
Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you, to do them; that you may live, and go in…
Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as Yahweh my God commanded me, that you should do so in the…
What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?
Moses called to all Israel, and said to them, “Hear, Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears…
Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Yahweh your God commanded to teach you, that…
that you might fear Yahweh your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you—you, your son…
These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances which Moses spoke to the children of Israel when they…
Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.
I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.
It shall be, when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write himself a copy of this law in a book, out…
“Remember the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded to him in Horeb for all Israel, even statutes and ordinances.
Therefore keep the words of this covenant and do them, that you may prosper in all that you do.
Only be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe to do according to all the law which Moses my servant…
This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe…
David went out wherever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely; and Saul set him over the men of war. It was good in…
David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and Yahweh was with him.
Then the princes of the Philistines went out; and as often as they went out, David behaved himself more wisely than all…
Hezekiah did so throughout all Judah; and he did that which was good, right, and faithful before Yahweh his God.
In every work that he began in the service of God’s house, in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did…
but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.
He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not…
Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.
My son, don’t forget my teaching; but let your heart keep my commandments:
Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. Yahweh…
He put garrisons in Edom. Throughout all Edom, he put garrisons, and all the Edomites became servants to David. Yahweh…
Yahweh was with him. Wherever he went, he prospered. He rebelled against the king of Assyria, and didn’t serve him.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: and keep the instruction of Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, his commandments, his ordinances, and his testimonies, according to that which is written in the law of Moses, that you may prosper in all that you do, and wherever you turn yourself.
translations.bsb: And keep the charge of the LORD your God to walk in His ways and to keep His statutes, commandments, ordinances, and decrees, as written in the Law of Moses, so that you may prosper in all you do and wherever you turn,
translations.kjv: And keep the charge of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself:
translations.asv: and keep the charge of Jehovah thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his ordinances, and his testimonies, according to that which is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself.
